abstract: Over the course of 110 years, SMPTE leadership has been at the forefront of the industry. Those who bear the title of SMPTE President have presided over a century of standardization, education initiatives, and a community of engaged, passionate peers. SMPTE has had many presidents over the past century, each making an indelible impact on the organization and the industry. While we certainly do not mean to minimize the contributions of any of them, we wanted to highlight a few to showcase SMPTE's evolution and the lasting influence of its leaders.
